# wallix-bastion_externalauth_oidc (Data Source)

Get information about an OIDC external authentication configured on the WALLIX Bastion (API v3.12
or later).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "wallix-bastion_externalauth_oidc" "corporate" {
  authentication_name = "corporate_oidc"
}

# The redirection URI to register on the identity provider
output "oidc_redirect_uri" {
  value = data.wallix-bastion_externalauth_oidc.corporate.redirect_uri
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `authentication_name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `claim_customization` (Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--claim_customization))
- `client_id` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `discovery_url` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `oidc_advanced_attributes` (Object) Null when not set on the Bastion. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--oidc_advanced_attributes))
- `redirect_uri` (String)
- `timeout` (Number)

<a id="nestedatt--claim_customization"></a>

### Nested Schema for `claim_customization`

Read-Only:

- `displayname` (String)
- `email` (String)
- `group` (String)
- `language` (String)
- `username` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--oidc_advanced_attributes"></a>

### Nested Schema for `oidc_advanced_attributes`

Read-Only:

- `authorization_endpoint` (String)
- `grant_type` (String)
- `id_token_signing_alg_values_supported` (List of String)
- `issuer` (String)
- `jwks_uri` (String)
- `response_type` (String)
- `scope` (List of String)
- `token_endpoint` (String)
- `userinfo_url_endpoint` (String)

## Usage Notes

`authentication_name` looks up the external authentication; the data source fails when no OIDC
external authentication has this name. The Bastion never returns the client secret, so the data
source has no attribute for it. `oidc_advanced_attributes` is null when the external
authentication has none.
